title: Modules
explain: Every file with an `import` or `export` is a module with its own scope. Export what other files may use, then import it by name from a relative path. `import type` brings in only a type, and it disappears when the code is compiled.
exercise: Split a small program into two files, export a function from one and import it in the other.
tip: In an ES module project (`"type": "module"`) using `NodeNext`, relative imports must end in `.js` even though the source file is `.ts`.
